p.title: v59.98 The AI action gate keeps advice to tidy a watchlist of 종목
p.symptom: An AI answer advising the reader to tidy their watchlist (관심 종목 + 정리하세요) was replaced with the no-trade-instruction notice.
p.root_cause: positionImperative in request-pipeline.js treated a bare 종목 as a position object for 정리하 as it does for 처분하 and 던지.
p.fix: With 정리하 the object must be 보유, 물량, 주식, 포지션, 비중, 지분 or 보유 종목; 처분하 and 던지 keep the full position-word list.
p.violated_rule: The directive gate replaces trade instructions, not ordinary guidance close to their wording.
p.prevention: ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check asserts two watchlist-tidy sentences stay and three held-position dispose sentences are still replaced.
p.verification: The kept case failed before the fix (both sentences replaced) and passes after; ci-regex-term-ratchet-check and ci-instruction-text-ratchet-check pass.

changelog: **AI 지시 관문의 '종목 정리' ({P}):** 관심 종목·오늘 본 종목을 정리하라는 안내는 그대로 두고, 보유 종목·주식·물량을 정리·처분하라는 문장만 매매 지시로 바꾼다.
note: v59.98: 정리 needs a held-position object
